parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL ID and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assays where the assay organism is Homo sapiens and the target is CHEMBL1827. Join molecule_dictionary to activities via molregno, join activities to assays via assay_id, join assays to target_dictionary via tid, and join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures via molregno. Filter assays.assay_organism equals Homo sapiens and target_dictionary.chembl_id equals CHEMBL1827. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles.
